source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the drug development process (PDF 209).

blocks.text: Drug development daryaft shuda dawa ko test karne aur awaam ke liye tayyar karne ka amal hai.

items: Preclinical tehqeeq: insani trials se pehle compounds in vitro (cell cultures) aur in vivo (janwaron) mein hifazat, zehreele pan aur asar ke liye jaanche jate hain.

Clinical trials, insanon par: phase 1 mein chhote group (20-100) sehatmand razakaron par hifazat aur khurak; phase 2 mein bare group (100-300) mareezon par asar aur zimni asraat; phase 3 ke bare trials (1,000-3,000) asar ki tasdeeq aur nuqsandeh rad-e-amal ki nigrani karte hain.
Regulatory review: FDA ya EMA jaise idare trials ka sab data jaanch kar market mein aane se pehle dawa manzoor ya radd karte hain.
Banana aur bechna: manzoor dawa bare paimane par banti aur dastiyab hoti hai.
Market ke baad nigrani: release ke baad dawa ke lambe aur kam milne wale zimni asraat ki nigrani hoti hai.

blocks.title: Pakistan mein
blocks.text: Kitab FDA (United States) aur EMA (Europe) ka naam leti hai. Pakistan mein dawaon ki registration aur nigrani Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP) karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa clinical trial phase 100-300 mareezon par asar aur zimni asraat jaanchta hai?

items: Preclinical (cells, janwar), phir insanon par phase 1, 2, 3.
Regulatory review, banana, market ke baad nigrani.
